parameters.jsCode:
// ============================================================
// NODE 5b — PARSE SESSION PLAN GEMINI RESPONSE
// ============================================================

const rawText = $input.first().json.text;

// Strip markdown code fences
const cleaned = rawText
  .replace(/```json/g, '')
  .replace(/```/g, '')
  .trim();

// Parse JSON
let ai;
try {
  ai = JSON.parse(cleaned);
} catch(e) {
  throw new Error('Failed to parse Gemini JSON: ' + cleaned.substring(0, 300));
}

const prev = $('SP Node 3 — Code node').first().json;

return [{
  json: {
    '{{unit_title}}':       prev.unit_title,
    '{{unit_code}}':        prev.unit_code,
    '{{trainer_name}}':     prev.trainer_name,
    '{{admission_no}}':     prev.admission_no,
    '{{institution}}':      prev.institution,
    '{{level}}':            prev.level,
    '{{class_name}}':       prev.class_name,
    '{{num_learners}}':     prev.num_learners,
    '{{week_no}}':          prev.week_no,
    '{{session_date}}':     prev.session_date,
    '{{session_time}}':     prev.session_time,
    '{{session_title}}':    prev.session_title,
    '{{learning_outcomes}}': ai.learning_outcomes,
    '{{references}}':       ai.references,
    '{{learning_aids}}':    ai.learning_aids,
    '{{safety_requirements}}': ai.safety_requirements,
    '{{intro_activity}}':   ai.intro_activity,
    '{{step1_trainer}}':    ai.step1_trainer,
    '{{step1_trainee}}':    ai.step1_trainee,
    '{{step1_time}}':       ai.step1_time,
    '{{step2a_trainer}}':   ai.step2a_trainer,
    '{{step2a_trainee}}':   ai.step2a_trainee,
    '{{step2a_time}}':      ai.step2a_time,
    '{{step2b_trainer}}':   ai.step2b_trainer,
    '{{step2b_trainee}}':   ai.step2b_trainee,
    '{{step2b_time}}':      ai.step2b_time,
    '{{step3_trainer}}':    ai.step3_trainer,
    '{{step3_trainee}}':    ai.step3_trainee,
    '{{step3_time}}':       ai.step3_time,
    '{{session_review}}':   ai.session_review,
    '{{follow_up}}':        ai.follow_up,
    '{{total_time}}':       ai.total_time,
    // Pass-through for next nodes
    _template_doc_id:   prev.template_doc_id,
    _output_folder_id:  prev.output_folder_id,
    _class_name:        prev.class_name,
    _week_no:           prev.week_no,
    _unit_title:        prev.unit_title,
    _session_date:      prev.session_date,
    _session_title:     prev.session_title,
    // Teacher's Notes fields
'{{tn_learning_outcomes}}':     ai.tn_learning_outcomes,
'{{prerequisites}}':            ai.prerequisites,
'{{content_notes}}':            ai.content_notes,
'{{worked_examples}}':          ai.worked_examples,
'{{misconceptions}}':           ai.misconceptions,
'{{tn_questions_low}}':         ai.tn_questions_low,
'{{tn_questions_mid}}':         ai.tn_questions_mid,
'{{tn_questions_high}}':        ai.tn_questions_high,
'{{practical_trainer_guide}}':  ai.practical_trainer_guide,
'{{practical_student_guide}}':  ai.practical_student_guide,
'{{assessment_knowledge}}':     ai.assessment_knowledge,
'{{assessment_skill}}':         ai.assessment_skill,
'{{assessment_attitude}}':      ai.assessment_attitude,
'{{tn_references}}':            ai.tn_references,
// Pass-through for TN nodes
_tn_template_doc_id: $('SP Node 3 — Code node').first().json.tn_template_doc_id || '',
  }
}];
